inputs.name: r2ScreenshotConfig.source
inputs.description: Environment-variable map used as the primary source for R2 settings. Account ID, bucket, and credentials fall back to localFile; the endpoint is read only from this map.

inputs.name: r2ScreenshotConfig.localFile
inputs.description: Optional file path whose matching R2 account, bucket, and credential assignments supply fallback values; a missing file is ignored only for ENOENT, while other read errors propagate. Defaults to undefined, which skips file reading.

inputs.name: r2ObjectKey.reportId
inputs.description: Report identifier passed to safeId to form the runs path segment in an object key. This adapter does not otherwise validate it.

inputs.name: r2ObjectKey.file
inputs.description: Screenshot filename used as the key's final path segment. It must be exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters followed by .png, .jpg, or .webp, or key creation throws.

inputs.name: R2ScreenshotStoreAdapter.constructor.config
inputs.description: R2 account ID, bucket, access key, secret key, and optional endpoint used to configure the adapter. If endpoint is omitted, the client uses the account-derived Cloudflare R2 endpoint.

inputs.name: R2ScreenshotStoreAdapter.constructor.client
inputs.description: Optional S3Client used to send screenshot requests. Defaults to undefined, which creates a client with region auto, path-style requests, the configured or account-derived endpoint, and the supplied credentials.

inputs.name: R2ScreenshotStoreAdapter.put.reportId
inputs.description: Report identifier passed to safeId to form the runs path segment in the screenshot object key. This adapter does not otherwise validate it.

inputs.name: R2ScreenshotStoreAdapter.put.file
inputs.description: Screenshot filename used as the key's final path segment. It must be exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters followed by .png, .jpg, or .webp, or the put promise rejects.

inputs.name: R2ScreenshotStoreAdapter.put.bytes
inputs.description: Binary screenshot contents sent as the PutObjectCommand body. The adapter forwards the Buffer without inspecting its contents.

inputs.name: R2ScreenshotStoreAdapter.put.mime
inputs.description: Content type sent as the PutObjectCommand ContentType. The adapter forwards this string without validating it.

inputs.name: R2ScreenshotStoreAdapter.get.reportId
inputs.description: Report identifier passed to safeId to form the runs path segment in the screenshot object key. This adapter does not otherwise validate it.

inputs.name: R2ScreenshotStoreAdapter.get.file
inputs.description: Screenshot filename used as the key's final path segment. It must be exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters followed by .png, .jpg, or .webp, or the get promise rejects.

outputs.name: screenshotObjectPrefix
outputs.description: Constant prefix prepended to every screenshot object key produced by this adapter.

outputs.name: r2ScreenshotConfig
outputs.type: { accountId: string; bucket: string; accessKeyId: string; secretAccessKey: string; endpoint: string | undefined; }
outputs.description: Resolved R2 configuration returned by the helper. Process values take precedence over local-file values, missing account, bucket, or credential values become empty strings, and endpoint comes only from the process environment.

outputs.name: r2ObjectKey
outputs.description: R2 key formed from uploaded-screenshots/runs/, safeId(reportId), /assets/, and the validated screenshot filename. The filename must match the 64-character lowercase hexadecimal pattern with a .png, .jpg, or .webp suffix.

outputs.name: R2ScreenshotStoreAdapter.fromEnvironment
outputs.description: New R2ScreenshotStoreAdapter built from process.env, with PROJECT_REPORTS_CONFIG_FILE read unless NODE_ENV is test. It requires account ID, bucket, access key, and secret key, and accepts an endpoint override only when it matches http://127.0.0.1:<port>.

outputs.name: R2ScreenshotStoreAdapter.put
outputs.description: Promise that resolves after the PutObjectCommand succeeds and has no resolved value. The command sends the configured bucket, generated key, provided Buffer, and MIME string.

outputs.name: R2ScreenshotStoreAdapter.get
outputs.description: Promise that resolves to a Buffer containing the response body bytes from GetObjectCommand. It rejects if the request fails or the response has no body.

errors.name: R2ScreenshotStoreError
errors.description: Thrown by r2ObjectKey when the filename is not 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters followed by .png, .jpg, or .webp; its message is Invalid R2 image name.

errors.name: R2ScreenshotStoreError
errors.description: Thrown by fromEnvironment when account ID, bucket, access key, or secret key is missing; its message is Cloudflare R2 screenshot storage is not configured.

errors.name: R2ScreenshotStoreError
errors.description: Thrown by fromEnvironment when an endpoint override does not match http://127.0.0.1:<port>; its message is R2 endpoint override must be a local test server.

errors.name: R2ScreenshotStoreError
errors.description: Thrown by get when the R2 response has no body; its message is R2 image has no body.

errors.name: R2 screenshot settings read failure
errors.description: Non-ENOENT errors from reading the optional local configuration file propagate unchanged; ENOENT is ignored.

errors.name: R2 screenshot request or response read failure
errors.description: Rejections from S3Client.send and response-body byte conversion propagate unchanged from the adapter.
